description.zh:
主机账号的ID列表。
> 此参数为必传参数。您可以调用[ListHostAccounts](~~462937~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The host account IDs.

> You must specify this parameter. You can call the [ListHostAccounts](~~462937~~) operation to query the host account IDs.

description.zh:
主机共享密钥的ID。
> 此参数为必传参数。您可以调用[ListHostShareKeys](~~462973~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The shared key ID.

> You must specify this parameter. You can call the [ListHostShareKeys](~~462973~~) operation to query the shared key ID.

description.zh: 堡垒机的实例ID。您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en: The ID of the bastion host. You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the ID of the bastion host.

description.zh: 堡垒机的地域ID。Region ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en: The region ID of the bastion host. For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

title.zh: 关联主机账号到主机共享密钥
